description: This file defines an abstract class DataFrameNaFunctions providing methods for handling missing data (nulls and NaNs) in Spark DataFrames, including dropping rows, filling nulls, and replacing values.

classes.name: DataFrameNaFunctions
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to handle missing data in DataFrames, such as dropping rows with nulls/NaNs, filling nulls, and replacing values.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Returns a new DataFrame dropping rows with null or NaN values based on specified conditions.

methods.name: drop(how: String)
methods.description: Drops rows with null or NaN values depending on 'how' parameter ('any' or 'all').

methods.name: drop(cols: Array[String])
methods.description: Drops rows with null or NaN in specified columns.

methods.name: drop(cols: Seq[String])
methods.description: Drops rows with null or NaN in specified columns (Scala-specific).

methods.name: drop(how: String, cols: Array[String])
methods.description: Drops rows with null or NaN in specified columns based on 'how' parameter.

methods.name: drop(how: String, cols: Seq[String])
methods.description: Drops rows with null or NaN in specified columns based on 'how' parameter (Scala-specific).

methods.name: drop(minNonNulls: Int)
methods.description: Drops rows with fewer than minNonNulls non-null/NaN values.

methods.name: drop(minNonNulls: Int, cols: Array[String])
methods.description: Drops rows with fewer than minNonNulls non-null/NaN values in specified columns.

methods.name: drop(minNonNulls: Int, cols: Seq[String])
methods.description: Drops rows with fewer than minNonNulls non-null/NaN values in specified columns (Scala-specific).

methods.name: fill(value: Long)
methods.description: Replaces null/NaN in numeric columns with specified Long value.

methods.name: fill(value: Double)
methods.description: Replaces null/NaN in numeric columns with specified Double value.

methods.name: fill(value: String)
methods.description: Replaces null in string columns with specified String value.

methods.name: fill(value: Long, cols: Array[String])
methods.description: Replaces null/NaN in specified numeric columns with Long value.

methods.name: fill(value: Double, cols: Array[String])
methods.description: Replaces null/NaN in specified numeric columns with Double value.

methods.name: fill(value: Long, cols: Seq[String])
methods.description: Replaces null/NaN in specified numeric columns with Long value (Scala-specific).

methods.name: fill(value: Double, cols: Seq[String])
methods.description: Replaces null/NaN in specified numeric columns with Double value (Scala-specific).

methods.name: fill(value: String, cols: Array[String])
methods.description: Replaces null in specified string columns with String value (Scala-specific).

methods.name: fill(value: String, cols: Seq[String])
methods.description: Replaces null in specified string columns with String value (Scala-specific).

methods.name: fill(value: Boolean)
methods.description: Replaces null in boolean columns with Boolean value.

methods.name: fill(value: Boolean, cols: Seq[String])
methods.description: Replaces null in specified boolean columns with Boolean value (Scala-specific).

methods.name: fill(value: Boolean, cols: Array[String])
methods.description: Replaces null in specified boolean columns with Boolean value (Scala-specific).

methods.name: fill(valueMap: util.Map[String, Any])
methods.description: Replaces nulls in columns with specified values from a Java Map.

methods.name: fill(valueMap: Map[String, Any])
methods.description: Replaces nulls in columns with specified values from a Scala Map.

methods.name: fillMap(values: Seq[(String, Any)])
methods.description: Internal method to fill nulls based on a sequence of column-value pairs.

methods.name: replace[T](col: String, replacement: util.Map[T, T])
methods.description: Replaces values in a column based on a Java Map of replacements.

methods.name: replace[T](cols: Array[String], replacement: util.Map[T, T])
methods.description: Replaces values in multiple columns based on a Java Map of replacements.

methods.name: replace[T](col: String, replacement: Map[T, T])
methods.description: Replaces values in a column based on a Scala Map of replacements.

methods.name: replace[T](cols: Seq[String], replacement: Map[T, T])
methods.description: Replaces values in multiple columns based on a Scala Map of replacements.
